source.author: cic
source.text: habeo enim regulam, ut talia visa vera iudicem qualia falsa esse non possint; ab hac mihi non licet transversum ut aiunt digitum discedere, ne confundam omnia; veri enim et falsi non modo cognitio sed etiam natura tolletur, si nihil erit quod intersit.
source.text_original: habeo enim regulam, ut talia visa vera iudicem qualia falsa esse non possint; ab hac mihi non licet transversum ut aiunt digitum discedere, ne confundam omnia; veri enim et falsi non modo cognitio sed etiam natura tolletur, si nihil erit quod intersit.
source.text_english: For I have a rule, that I judge such appearances to be true as cannot possibly be false; from this I am not allowed, as they say, to move a finger’s breadth aside, lest I throw everything into confusion; for not only will the knowledge but even the nature of truth and falsehood be abolished, if there is nothing that makes a difference.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: uigiliarum dies et sollemnes pernoctationes sic uirguncula nostra celebret, ut ne transuersum quidem unguem a matre discedat.
reuse.text_original: uigiliarum dies et sollemnes pernoctationes sic uirguncula nostra celebret, ut ne transuersum quidem unguem a matre discedat.
reuse.text_english: Let our little maiden celebrate the days of vigils and the all-night festivals in such a way that she does not depart from her mother even the breadth of a nail’s turn.
